title: Appearance & Customization
intro: We offer a wide range of carbon fiber weave patterns and surface finishes to meet the aesthetic and performance preferences of every rider. All weaves are structural carbon fiber, not printed or laminated.

images.matteAlt: Carbon rim matte surface finish detail
images.glossyAlt: Carbon rim glossy surface finish detail

crystalIntro: Crystal finishes use micro-layer coating technology for unique light reflection and color depth.
brakeTrackNote: All brake tracks are heat-treated and abrasion-tested for compatibility with mainstream brake pads.

laser.body: In addition to traditional decals and painted graphics, we support laser-engraved logos as a sustainable, faster option.

bullets.0: Reduces plastic waste by avoiding vinyl decals and masks.

laser.guideNote: See our Wheelset Buyers Guide for more advice on choosing between laser and decals.

suggestions.title: Presentation Suggestions

items.0: Organize options into three clear sections: Weave, Brake Track, and Finish.
items.1: Pair each option with a high-resolution image and concise label.
items.2: Include recommended combinations or customer favorites to guide decision-making.

suggestions.footer: For OEM clients, team orders, or custom branding requests, we offer logo integration, laser etching, and color matching services. Contact us for tailored solutions.
